name: Video ➡️ 3D by 13Labs (Best Dev Tool & TwelveLabs API @ HT6)
tagline: Turns a video, even from a Raspberry Pi feed, into an interactive animated 3D scene in the browser.

awards: TwelveLabs: Best Use of TwelveLabs API (Podium)

problem: AI can describe video but not rebuild it as something you can interact with.
solution: A pipeline detects key objects, their motion and geometry from video and reconstructs an explorable, animated 3D scene.
demo_moment: Team-described: record a scene and walk around it in 3D.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “TwelveLabs: Best Use of TwelveLabs API (Podium)” and “Warp: Best Developer Tool” among 131 submissions.
Won a video-API podium and the developer-tool prize.

lessons: Video-to-something-interactive is a striking use of video APIs.
